And Let Me Guess, You’re Probably Already Thinking…

“I don’t have enough followers.”

Neither did I. Brands don’t care about your follower count — they care about your energy, your engagement, and whether you actually use what they’re selling. That’s it.

“I’m not pretty enough or too old for this.”

Brands don’t want one look. Their customers are every age, every size, every background — so they need girls who actually reflect that, not one specific “type.” There’s no look that gets picked. There’s just girls who show up and pitch.

“This only works if you live somewhere specific.”

Brand deals are global. Whether you’re in a big city or a small town, in the US or overseas, brands ship worldwide and pay through platforms that work from anywhere. If you’ve got Wi-Fi and a phone, you’re in business.

“I don’t have time for this.”

You don’t need hours a day. Most girls land their first deal spending less time than they spend scrolling at night before bed.

“What if brands don’t respond to me?”

Then you pitch again. One brand not responding isn’t the end of anything — it’s one email closer to a yes. The system shows you how to keep your pipeline full so a quiet inbox never feels like a dead end.

“This sounds too good to be true.”

Because you were doing it alone — no plan, no templates, no one to ask when you got stuck. This isn’t that.
